table.retrieve:
SELECT
	InvoiceCode = S.InvoiceCode, 
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Supplier=A.Name,
	Date = S.Date,
	DocumentCode= S.DocumentCode, 
	VoucherCode= S.VoucherCode, 
	Type = S.Type,
	Remarks = S.Remarks,
	RefNo = S.RefNo,
	Debit = S.Debit, 
	Credit = S.Credit,
	Posted = S.Posted
FROM
	(SELECT  
		InvoiceCode = S.PurInvCode, 
		Date = S.Date,
		DocumentCode= S.PurInvCode, 
		VoucherCode= S.HeaderInvNo, 
		Type = 'PI',
		Remarks = 'Purchase Invoice',
		RefNo = S.SuppInvCode,
		Debit = 0,
		Credit = S.InvTotal, 
		Posted = S.Posted
	FROM
		PurLedger S
	Where    
		S.PurInvCode = :ai_invcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		InvoiceCode = S.PurInvCode, 
		Date = S.Date,
		DocumentCode= S.PurInvCode, 
		VoucherCode= S.HeaderInvNo, 
		Type = 'PDP',
		Remarks = 'Paid During Purchase',
		RefNo = S.SuppInvCode,
		Debit = IsNull(S.Amt,0),
		Credit = 0, 
		Posted = S.Posted
	FROM
		PurLedger S
	Where    
		S.PurInvCode = :ai_invcode AND   
		S.Amt <> 0 AND
		S.AccountFor = 'Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		InvoiceCode = D.InvoiceCode,
		Date = H.Date,
		DocumentCode= H.GLVochcode, 
		VoucherCode= H.VoucherCode, 
		Type = VC.ShortName,
		Remarks = VC.Name,
		RefNo = H.ChkNo,
		Debit = D.Debit, 
		Credit = D.Credit,
		Posted = H.Posted
	FROM
		GLDetail D,
		GLHeader H,
		VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND   
		D.InvoiceCode = :ai_invcode AND   
		VC.InvoiceType = 2 AND   
		VC.VochCatCode = H.VochCatCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		InvoiceCode = D.InvoiceCode,
		Date = N.IssueDate,
		DocumentCode= N.NoteCode, 
		VoucherCode= N.VoucherCode, 
		Type = 'BP',
		Remarks = 'Bills Payables',
		RefNo = N.DocumentNumber,
		Debit = D.Amt,
		Credit = 0, 
		Posted = N.Posted
	FROM NotesDetail D, Notes N
	Where
		N.NoteCatCode = 2 AND   
		N.NoteCode = D.NoteCode AND   
		D.InvoiceCode = :ai_invcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		InvoiceCode = D.PurInvCode, 
		Date = H.Date,
		DocumentCode= H.PRAllocationCode, 
		VoucherCode= H.PRInvCode, 
		Type = 'PRA',
		Remarks = 'P/Return Allocated',
		RefNo = '',
		Debit = D.Amt,
		Credit = 0, 
		Posted = H.Posted
	FROM
		PRALLocationDetail D, PRALLocationHeader H
	Where
		H.PRALLocationCode = D.PRALLocationCode AND   
		D.PurInvCode = :ai_invcode) S,
	Accounts A,
	PurLedger SL
WHERE 
	SL.PurInvCode = :ai_invcode AND
	SL.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.PurInvCode = S.InvoiceCode
ORDER BY 
	InvoiceCode,
	Date
